title: Shopee marks 6 million affiliate milestone as creator-led commerce grows in the Philippines

blocks.text: Shopee’s affiliate community in the Philippines has grown to more than six million creators, a milestone announced at Shopee Creators’ Night 2026, the company’s annual celebration of creators, affiliates, MCN partners, and brands behind the platform’s growth. The scale of creator-led commerce on Shopee has grown rapidly. Today, affiliates drive half of all orders on the platform and account for a quarter of total traffic. Creator-driven traffic and sales increased by more than 50% this year, while Shopee Live and Video continued to expand, with user growth of 1.2 times and watch time up 1.5 times year-on-year. “Creators are playing an […]...
